notes.title: Pool Version 1.6.128 Update
notes.notes:
Update to address the following:
* Redirects user to the steam store for the title if the user does not own it.
* If the user owns the other title, it closes game and loads the selected game.

notes.title: Build 1.4.74 - Fixin' Bugs!
notes.notes:
Hot off the heels of our launch, build 1.4.74 addresses the following issues:

[list]
[*]Increased NPC detail in the halls.
[*]Fixed hamburger button for the quest controllers to bring up the settings menu.
[*]Fixed saving user avatars in between game sessions.
[/list]
